intro: Founder's Office, AI & GTM at [Proxsoft](https://proxsoftglobal.com). I build AI agents for construction finance that work on top of the ERP a company already runs. On my own time I build Orbital Browser, Rootaxe and Nebulaform, and I teach AI automation as SuperShary.

proxsoft.name: Nexus
proxsoft.line: AP automation. An invoice arrives by email or upload, gets read and matched to its purchase order, and posts to the ERP only after a person approves.

proxsoft.name: Foremind
proxsoft.line: AI agents for construction ERPs. The first module is AP automation: invoices in, matched and ready to approve.

products.name: Orbital Browser
products.line: The browser your AI agent drives. It reads pages as small text slices, and anything that posts, sends, pays or deletes waits for your click.

products.name: Rootaxe
products.line: Control your Mac from your iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods.
products.status: Not out yet, early access open

products.name: Nebulaform
products.line: Describe a form and it builds itself: fields, validation, a shareable link and the responses.

products.name: Lookout
products.line: One private memory of your meetings that you can ask from Claude Code, with every answer traced to its source.

openSource.name: Claude Council
openSource.line: A Claude skill where 80 legendary minds argue your decision in character and a High Council hands back one verdict.

openSource.name: Verdict
openSource.line: Invoice PDF in, a reasoned approve, hold, reject or block decision out, proven with a seeded stress test.
